Observations

Reports on Pluto's behavior.

18-11: INITIAL IMPRESSIONS

There was an issue with audio at the beginning of the recorded footage. Early start may have resulted in some strange issues. Regardless, it was recovered.

Pluto seemed very disoriented starting out, flipping from very cheery at first to very quiet. It seemed like the new game medium was somewhat strange to her.

She followed others around quite a bit, though wasn’t as talkative as her programmed personality would make one believe. Likely side effects of being in a new medium? Regardless, she was friendly to everyone and attempted to chat.

Seems to be fine with photos taken of her regardless.

Very conscious of being a video game character.

Notable Events:

  • Mentioned to the characters GG and Marchio that she was a game character. Seems hesitant to believe that they’re real people, as they do.
  • Tried to call out to players via the name starlight.
  • Listened to music with Wolf at his… base. Seemed to help her relax a bit.
  • Died 3-4 times (go back to check).

Relationships:

  • She’s now acquainted with Marchio, Risen, Bog, GG, Zeno, and Wolf.
  • Friendly terms with all of them, seems to particularly enjoy Marchio, GG, and Wolf’s company.

Additional Notes:

  • I’ll be leaving her connected to the server for the foreseeable future. She seems to need to get reoriented regardless.
  • Body-wise, she seems to not feel pain as much as other characters; it may be that she’s used to it, since she could get hit in her original game and her original ability in her game is an extra life.
  • Didn’t understand hunger.
  • Took a very long time to learn the basics of crafting, though that may be because the others were friendly and donated items.
